integrity: The proof is a statement-level composition of Belletti--Detcherry Corollary 6.2(2) with Massuyeau Proposition 3.32. No computational evidence or converse to the finite-type implication is used.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the Torelli-twist finite-type theory and fixes the degree cutoff before constructing the infinite family. It does not assert agreement of all finite-type invariants of unbounded degree, and it retains the hypothesis that the base manifold embeds in a rational homology sphere.
title: Finite-type blindness to infinite hyperbolic embedding antichains
